1.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
1.summary: The US president was reportedly part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

2.title: Trump Picks Project 2025 Co-Author for Role That Would Oversee Any Reflecting Pool Review
2.summary: Dennis Kirk, a former adviser to Tulsi Gabbard, is President Trump’s nominee for inspector general for the Interior Department.

3.title: Wildfire Forces Evacuations in Big Sur, Along California’s Famed Central Coast
3.summary: A fire broke out near Highway 1 on Sunday and spread rapidly overnight, prompting evacuation orders across Monterey County.

4.title: Syria Sentences Former President al-Assad to Death for Crimes Against Humanity
4.summary: The former president was convicted of crimes against humanity during the country’s civil war, the first verdict since he fled to Russia in 2024.

5.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
5.summary: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.
